prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 work trip—everything was centered around Beijing, and we kept bouncing between meals and meetings.
Funny thing is, the hotel part was also in Beijing—my coworker kept joking he’d basically memorized the lobby by the end.
And yeah, the flight leg everyone talked about was Beijing to Shanghai—total blur now, but that route came up nonstop in our chat.
For lunch one day, they’d already booked a big table at Beijing Garden on 2025-03-03, and it was set for 12:00.
It was a party of 7, and the reservation was under Chen Ming—someone even pasted 13845678901 into the group thread back then.
Later that month we stayed at Grand Mercure Beijing; check-in was 2025-03-21 for 5 nights, and it was under Zhou Jun.
The flight itself was MU5890 on 2025-03-02—China Eastern—and the passenger name on it was Zhou Jun, so that detail stuck with me.
